# Apartman Strong

> Apartman Strong is a five-star apartment rental in Slavonski Brod, Croatia,
> offering two modern, luxuriously furnished apartments for short stays.

Location: Naselje Andrije Hebranga 2/6, 35000 Slavonski Brod, Croatia
Phone: +385 91 893 5340
Email: sb.dejan@gmail.com
Website: https://apartmanstrong.hr

## Apartments
- Apartman Strong 1 — spacious unit with a carefully appointed living room, bedroom and a luxury bathroom.
- Apartman Strong 2 — ideal for couples or small families; tastefully decorated interior with a private terrace, minutes from the city centre.

## House rules
- Check in: 15:00–24:00
- Check out: 07:00–11:30
- Cancellation: free up to 3 days before arrival
- Payment: cash only
- Pets: not allowed
- Smoking: not permitted indoors
